name: A2 Everyday Grammar Lab
description: Pre-intermediate review of tenses, comparatives, prepositions & error correction (5×4).

questions.q: What is the past simple form of 'buy'?
What is the comparative form of 'good'?
Choose in / on / at: 'The meeting starts ___ 9:30 AM.'
Choose much / many: 'How ___ bottles of water do we need?'
Fix: 'He don't like waking up early.'
questions.a: He doesn't like waking up early.

questions.q: Complete: 'Yesterday we ___ (visit) our grandparents.'
Complete: 'An elephant is ___ (heavy) than a cat.'
Choose in / on / at: 'My birthday is ___ October.'
Choose a / an / some: 'Would you like ___ sugar in your tea?'
Fix: 'She is more tall than her brother.'
questions.a: She is taller than her brother.

questions.q: Make negative: 'She finished her homework.'
Complete: 'This puzzle is the ___ (difficult) in the book!'
Choose in / on / at: 'The keys are ___ the kitchen table.'
Correct or incorrect: 'I bought three advices yesterday.'
questions.a: Incorrect ('advice' is uncountable -> some/pieces of advice)

questions.q: Fix: 'Did you saw the football match last night?'
questions.a: Did you see the football match last night?

questions.q: Ask a Past Simple question with 'you / go / beach'.
questions.a: Did you go to the beach?

questions.q: Compare summer and winter using an adjective.
Fill both blanks: 'I travel ___ bus ___ Monday mornings.'
Name 3 uncountable food or drink nouns.
questions.a: Water, rice, bread, cheese, coffee, milk (any 3)

questions.q: Fix two mistakes: 'There is many peoples in the park.'
questions.a: There are many people in the park.
